title: fix(connectInfiniteHits): fix state when navigating or adding/removing widgets
body:
**Summary**

This PR fix multiple issues that were spotted after the merge of https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4104:

* Set `page` to `0` by default so the widget does not get controlled by its parent (fixes https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4104#discussion\_r324602461).
* Excludes `facets`, `maxValuesPerFacet` and filter `facetsRefinements` when comparing the currentState with the prevState (fixes https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4104#discussion\_r324602609).
